summary: Upgrade TORGNEXA operator surfaces for enterprise data volume and incident response with server-owned cursor grids, protected metadata-only realtime invalidation, unified incident triage, durable deep routes/server search and reporting-backed analytics without creating browser authority.

impacts.evidence: Server DataGrid, realtime, incident composition, deep links and command search reuse canonical request scope; no organization/workspace selector or cross-tenant browser index is introduced.
The SSE channel sends only reason/cursor/timestamp invalidation metadata and never audit summaries, credentials or business entities; browser storage policy remains unchanged.
One additive protected GET /api/v1/realtime operation (streamRealtimeInvalidations) moves OpenAPI to 0.15.0 and generated SDKs to 108 operations; existing endpoints remain compatible.
No event envelope, topic, producer, consumer or schema changes; browser realtime is an API invalidation channel, not direct Kafka/event payload exposure.
Connector SDK/provider contracts remain unchanged; UI continues using generated public APIs and connector catalog data.
Task 120 adds no schema migration; migration count remains 74 with latest 000074.

Realtime is registered as a ProtectedRoute with operations.realtime.read; bearer authentication, canonical tenant resolution, authorization and RLS remain authoritative. Deep links and search do not bypass these gates.
Incident Center exposes pending approvals as triage data but does not alter approval decision/execution semantics or create a browser-side approval path.
The realtime API reads only the newest tenant audit identifier as a change watermark; raw immutable audit payloads are explicitly excluded from the stream.
Incident Center exposes current open drift and directs operators to existing reconciliation workflows; no write/idempotency transition changes.
No new outbound webhook or browser third-party egress is introduced; SSE is same-origin API response traffic.

Operators gain live connection state, one incident queue and reporting-backed KPIs; non-audited worker state receives bounded heartbeat refresh fallback rather than an unqualified sub-second guarantee.
No schema migration exists; rollback is deployment of the previous API/frontend pair. The additive realtime route can be removed with the prior compatible OpenAPI/client bundle.
Frontend deterministic UX coverage expands from 18 to 23 tests; generated SDK gate validates 108 operations; a focused realtime handler test asserts tenant-scoped metadata-only streaming.
